content:
Joining the return of Amazon discount on the new Apple TV 4K and the now even lower price on AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off, it has also loaded its early Black Friday sale up with a super rare discount on MacBook Neo. You will now find $50 price drops on both the 256GB and 512GB configs in various colorways for the lowest prices we have tracked in approaching 6 months. On top of that you’ll find all colors of the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now at $250 off, the best prices we have ever tracked on just about every Apple Watch Series 12 model out there, and the now live Nomad 2026 Black Friday sale – rare deals on iPhone cases, Apple Watch bands, Find My gear, and much more. Just be sure to score yourself Apple’s 40W Dynamic Power iPhone Duo fast charger while it’s at one of the lowest prices ever before you head below for a closer look at everything.

Amazon updates early Black Friday sale with loads of new deals: AirPods, Apple Watch Series 12, Fold 8, PlayStation, more

Heads up! AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to one of the lowest prices ever ahead of Black Friday ($70 off)

Amazon’s early Black Friday sale is live with all-time lows on AirTag 2 at $17.50, the now even lower $70 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, and M5 MacBook Air at up to $250 off, but we are also now tracking Apple Watch Series 12 at the best price ever – you’ll now find several configurations at a seriously notable $70 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 shipped. That’s nearly $70 off and one of the lowest prices ever.

Hello! Super rare $50 price drops hit MacBook Neo lineup today in early Black Friday sale

Today we are getting some extremely rare price drops and the best prices in months on MacBook Neo in brand new condition. As part of its now updated early Black Friday sale, and joining the now even lower price on AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off and all-time lows across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, we are actually now tracking some surprising deals on several MacBook Neo configurations at nearly $50 off the list prices.

Amazon is now offering the 256GB entry MacBook Neo down at $649.99 shipped and the upgraded 512GB model with the Touch ID keyboard down at $749.99 shipped.

  • MacBook Neo 256GB $650 (Reg. $700)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB $750 (Reg. $800)

While not all colors on both storage configs are seeing the deals, most of them are.

Outside of a couple one-off deals and the Apple Certified Refurbished discounts, deals on MacBook Neo have otherwise been nearly non-existent.

The only place to score these machines for less are in refurbished condition straight from Apple. You will save an additional $50 on the 256GB model and $71 on the 512GB with the same warranty as a new machine – that may our may not be enough for some folks to warrant side stepping the brand new models at Amazon:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

Secure Amazon’s deal on new Apple TV 4K before shipping delays get worse

The early Black Friday Apple deals are soaring this week with AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off, the lowest prices ever on Apple Watch Series 12, and a rare MacBook Neo discount, among many others, but we also wanted to highlight the return of Amazon’s deal on the new Apple TV 4K – it’s not a giant discount, but you had better lock one in sooner than later before delivery times start to slip even further.

Amazon is once again offering the brand new Apple TV 4K with the latest Siri Remote down at $289.99 shipped.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K $289 (Reg. $299)

Most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air now $250 off in all colors (Best in several months)

Amazon is not playing around the early Black Friday Apple deals this week, after seeing it drop the price on AirPods Pro 3 to one of its best ever, the lowest prices to date across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, and now, an extremely rare $50 price drop on the affordable MacBook Neo. But for folks looking to get into a more power machine without spending Pro money, all colors of the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air are now at the lowest in months with $250 in savings.

We spotted this same deal yesterday, but it was only live on the Midnight color, however as of this morning you’ll find the entry 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD sitting down at $1,249.99 shipped.

Regularly $1,499, this is just shy of $250 off and the best price we have tracked since late June with all colors up for grabs.

Today’s deal makes for a notable chance to secure Apple’s latest and most affordable M5-powered MacBook Air with the more roomy screen real-estate, but there are still a couple lingering deals across the lineup for folks eyeing a different configuration:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,499) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999)

For something even more affordable than you’ll ever seen on the M5 MacBook Air, go secure yourself the ultra-rare deal on MacBook Neo starting from $650.

Hello! Apple Watch Series 12 just hit the best price ever at $70 off in early Black Friday sale

Amazon is now offering the latest Apple Series 12 models at the lowest price we have tracked since release in September – these deals include the base 42mm and 46mm models, as well as the GPS + Cell variants:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $329 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $379 (Reg. $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $429 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $479 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium: $629 (Reg. $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $679 (Reg. $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $729 (Reg. $799)

You’re looking at deals on the most affordable models starting from $329 shipped to deliver new Amazon all-time lows and the best deals since release. More specifically speaking, the base 42mm GPS-only models are now sitting down at $329 shipped, while the 46mm variants are now starting at $379, down from the regular $449 list price.

Luxurious new Ceramic Apple Watch Series 12 hits best price ever at $70 off (Pearl and Night colors)

Alongside the now even lower price on AirPods Pro 3 at $70, we are also getting some of the first discounts on Apple’s luxurious new Ceramic Apple Watch Series 12 in the gorgeous Pearl White colorway and the super sleek Night Blue.

As mentioned above, you will now find the standard and most popular aluminum Apple Watch Series

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Pearl White $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Night Blue $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic Night Blue $879 (Reg. $949) – All-time low

We did catch a lighter deal on the Night Blue models during the fall Prime Day, But this is the very first chance to save on the particularly gorgeous Pearl White model.

Score a current-gen Apple Watch at just $199 in the early Amazon Black Friday sale

  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Midnight $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Starlight $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Midnight $229 (Reg. $279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Starlight $229 (Reg. $279)

Don’t need four of them? Single AirTag 2 now down at $23 Amazon all-time low

The Amazon early Black Friday deals are flying and we are catching some seriously great official Apple accessory deals, from nearly 25% off Magic Mouse to a collection of official Apple Watch bands at up to 34% off, and even Apple Magic Trackpad all-time lows. The most notable of which for me, however, has to be the AirTag 2 deals. Not only can you score the 4-pack back at the lowest price ever, but the single listing is now sitting at the $23 Prime shipped all-time low.

Early Black Friday AirTag 2 deals

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – NEW all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Official 2026 Nomad Black Friday now live: iPhone cases, Watch bands, Find My card, more up to 25% off

The official 2026 Nomad Black Friday sale has arrived. This is the best sale of the year from what it is easily one of the best Apple gear and tech accessory brands in the business, and just about everything is now on sale via the official site.

  • Nomad iPhone Cases up to 25% off
  • Nomad Apple Watch Bands up to 20% off
  • Nomad Charging gear up to 25% off

Bose QuietComfort Headphones: A perfect gift for just about anyone at up to $190 off

  • Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) $340 (Reg. $449)
  • Bose – QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) $199 (Reg. $359)
  • Bose QuietComfort Headphones $169 (Reg. $359)
  • And even more…

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • This tiny 10,000mAh 45W power bank with built-in USB-C cable is only $20 today (50% off)
  • Hohem’s iSteady M7 AI gimbal with detachable touchscreen hits new $199 all-time low ahead of Black Friday
  • Blink cameras: High-tech smart home gifts you can pickup from just $16 this year
  • Samsung’s 27-inch ViewFinity 5K productivity monitor with 90W USB-C hits new $500 low ahead of Black Friday
  • Aiper’s HydroSync upgrades your pool with solar-powered 5-in-1 testing at $280 (Reg. $360)
  • Pair your Indigo MacBook Neo with ORICO’s 32GB USB-C flash drive for just $9.50 (Save 41%)

Apple’s 40W Dynamic Power iPhone Duo fast charger just dropped to $29 at Amazon (Over 25% off)

Alongside the all-time lows now live on Apple Watch Series 12 and the now even lower early Black Friday discount on AirPods Pro 3 (now at one of the lowest prices ever), Amazon has also just dropped the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down to one of its best prices at $29 – this is the model Apple recommends for fast charging on iPhone Duo.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down at $29 shipped.

This is a regularly $39 charger now at over 25% off the list to deliver the best deal we can find.

We featured a notable discount on this model as the iPhone Duo started to land on door steps across the country at $35, but Amazon has now dropped the price even lower to deliver the best deal we have tracked since the new Apple foldable made landfall.

Over on the Apple support pages, it specifically recommends this model for fast charging iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and the new iPhone Duo.
